versions.content: If parameter FrIf_StateTransition of FrIf_SetState has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function F rIf_SetState shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_FRIF_STATE to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.

If parameter FrIf_StateTransition of FrIf_SetState has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), t he function FrIf_SetState shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_FRIF_STATE to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.

If parameter FrIf_StateTransition of FrIf_SetState has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_SetState shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_FR IF_STATE to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.

If parameter FrIf_StateTransition of FrIf_SetState has an invalid value and if development error detection is enabled (i.e. FrIfDevErrorDetect equals ON), the function FrIf_SetState shall report development error code FRIF_E_INV_ FRIF_STATE to the Det_ReportError service of the DET module.
